description: S450 (S447 ruling iii) — a server-call cell write NESTED in a 1-statement handler (an `if` body, the `else if` limb of an if / else-if / else chain, a `match` arm) is awaited before the next statement, so the read of the written cell sees the resolved value: y = 10 + 1, z = 10 + 2, w = 10 + 3. Before the fix the write was a detached fire-and-forget IIFE and each read saw the pre-fetch 0 (y = 1, z = 2, w = 3).
rationale: §13.2: "The compiler SHALL insert `await` at every call site where a server-generated fetch call is made" and (S450) a server-call cell write in a handler SHALL be awaited in place unless it is the handler's SOLE root statement — here every write is nested, so the statement after it observes the resolved value.
